source_snapshot.procedure: Verify FRU is programmed and run local raw 0x2c 0x08 0xdc 0 0x10 <Asset tag data>.

historical_reviews.deepseek: The confirmation gate is correct, but raw payload equivalence, local transport and downstream asset ownership are not established.
historical_reviews.gpt_v2: Correctly treats the persistent identity change as recoverable prerequisite-driven work.
historical_reviews.history: The invalidated prior-run location was found but excluded as authority; both getter routes were checked to define complete baseline evidence.
historical_reviews.v3_1: An asset-tag setter must protect the asset registry as well as the bytes stored on the BMC/FRU surface.

original_test_intent: Write one authorized asset tag via the local DCMI path, verify exact persistence and inventory propagation, and restore the original value when required.
original_method: Preserve raw 0x2c 0x08 0xdc and the local route, but require an exact encoded tag based on the approved asset record and a complete getter baseline before one write.
manual_activity: The asset/BMC owner approves the exact tag, character/length encoding, authoritative ownership record, persistence/consumer scope, maintenance window and original-value restoration.
required_inputs: Exact replacement tag and encoded bytes
safety_requirements: Never invent or reuse an example tag
Prevent temporary tag from changing production ownership
Read back complete value and consumers
agent_execution_scope: Validate exact set and restore payloads
Check inventory consumer behavior and persistence
engineer_actions: Approve target, tag, consumer impact and rollback
Protect asset ownership during the window

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: The high-level setter requires proven raw equivalence and its remote SSH wrapper does not match the local source path; generic ASSET_TAG input alone is insufficient.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: After baseline and approval, execute local raw 0x2c 0x08 0xdc 0 0x10 <approved-asset-tag-data> once, then retrieve the complete tag, verify consumers and restore under the plan.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: The source opcode, local route, FRU prerequisite and 10/5 timing remain; no tag bytes are guessed.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Manage the tag as controlled asset master-data: approve a valid temporary value, make one exact write, verify complete storage and named consumers, then restore the authoritative baseline.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds semantic inventory ownership and recovery to the raw write rather than accepting completion alone.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: The getter only establishes read-back; it does not prove setter acceptance, persistence or downstream inventory propagation.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: A wrong or temporary tag can reassign the system in CMDB, provisioning or service workflows even though the hardware remains healthy.

project_override_considerations: A vendor or Redfish setter may substitute only with documented equivalence and the same raw/consumer/restore evidence; uncovered raw coverage must be disclosed.
expected_evidence: Complete getter before/after bytes and decoded values

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: The Master item, FRU prerequisite and 0x08 command consistently describe an asset-tag write. The open data placeholder and command-success criterion are incomplete, not contradictory.

blocked_analysis.analysis: The target operation is identifiable. Exact tag, schema, baseline, approval, consumer policy and restore are explicit prerequisites.

review_improvement: Expands a syntactic write into a governed, evidence-backed and reversible asset-identity transaction.
independent_technical_reasoning: Asset tags connect hardware to external ownership systems, so correctness cannot stop at a successful BMC write. The exact encoded value must be authorized, fully read back and checked where it is consumed. Restoration must reestablish both stored bytes and authoritative inventory correlation without blind retries.
